parameters.name: kylin_conn_id
parameters.description: The connection id as configured in Airflow administration.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: kylin project name, this param will overwrite the project in kylin_conn_id:

parameters.name: dsn
parameters.description: (dsn , dsn url of kylin connection ,which will overwrite kylin_conn_id. for example: kylin://ADMIN:KYLIN@sandbox/learn_kylin?timeout=60&is_debug=1)

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: (kylin command include 'build', 'merge', 'refresh', 'delete', 'build_streaming', 'merge_streaming', 'refresh_streaming', 'disable', 'enable', 'purge', 'clone', 'drop'. build - use /kylin/api/cubes/{cubeName}/build rest api,and buildType is 'BUILD', and you should give start_time and end_time refresh - use build rest api,and buildType is 'REFRESH' merge - use build rest api,and buildType is 'MERGE' build_streaming - use /kylin/api/cubes/{cubeName}/build2 rest api,and buildType is 'BUILD' and you should give offset_start and offset_end refresh_streaming - use build2 rest api,and buildType is 'REFRESH' merge_streaming - use build2 rest api,and buildType is 'MERGE' delete - delete segment, and you should give segment_name value disable - disable cube enable - enable cube purge - purge cube clone - clone cube,new cube name is {cube_name}_clone drop - drop cube)

parameters.name: is_track_job
parameters.description: (whether to track job status. if value is True,will track job until job status is in("FINISHED", "ERROR", "DISCARDED", "KILLED", "SUICIDAL", "STOPPED") or timeout)

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: timeout value,default value is 1 day,60 * 60 * 24 s

parameters.name: eager_error_status
parameters.description: (jobs error status,if job status in this list ,this task will be error. default value is tuple(["ERROR", "DISCARDED", "KILLED", "SUICIDAL", "STOPPED"]))

parameters.name: kylin_conn_id
parameters.description: The connection id as configured in Airflow administration.
